name: fpt-library-management
description: Ứng dụng quản lý sách thư viện — orchestrator chạy client (React) + server (Express) cùng lúc.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client run preview"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
